all_done: You've learned them all! Review time 🏆
enabled_help: When off, the cat won't come until you turn it back on.
how_often_help: Each question comes at a random time in this range.
idle_help: If you haven't used the keyboard or mouse for this long, KEDYY waits until you're back. 0 = off.
retire_help: Remove a card after you answer it correctly this many times.
sound_answer_help: A happy chime when you're right, a sad one when you're not.
sound_open_help: A little “meow” when the cat appears.
language_help: Changes the app's own text. Your decks can be in any language.
decks_help: Every file is a deck, in any language or about any topic. Turned-off decks aren't asked; deleting removes KEDYY's copy (your original file is untouched).
no_decks: No decks yet — add one with “Add file”.
formats_files: File types: {list}. One card per line, numbered or not:
formats_csv: CSV/TSV: column 1 = front, column 2 = back, column 3 (optional) = note. A trailing ( … ) is shown as a note.
formats_meta: Optional header lines name the deck and its sides:
reset_help: Clears your right/wrong history. Decks are kept.
confirm_delete: Delete the “{name}” deck? Its cards won't be asked anymore.
confirm_reset: Clear all your right/wrong history? This can't be undone.
err_empty: No cards found in this file. Each line should look like “front — back”.
